title: AERO9500 Preliminary Report (Part 1)
overview: Plan a simple space mission that benefits Australia and present preliminary design work to guide the full mission assignment. Explain the mission concept and rationale, plan how the assignment will be completed, identify information sources and software, and show evidence of technical progress.
deliverables: A preliminary report describing the mission concept and its rationale, including what the mission will do, its users and why it is needed.
A project plan for completing the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and planned information sources.
Preliminary technical work demonstrating progress on the mission design.
The software package selected for the design.

format.structure: No prescribed section headings; include the mission concept and rationale, project plan, planned information sources, software choice and preliminary technical work.
format.other: Submit as one PDF document. Hand calculations may be used to supplement software work but are encouraged, not required.

requirements.text: Design a simple space-mission concept that benefits Australia; explain its purpose, intended users and rationale.
Relate the preliminary plan to the mission’s space segment, applying relevant course material such as launch and orbits.

Select the software package to use for the mission design. If using software other than STK, PIGI or flightclub, contact Naomi before starting; PIGI users must register for its competition to obtain a software licence.
Provide a project plan explaining how you intend to complete the assignment, using either a Gantt chart or a timetable.
List the information sources you plan to use.
Include preliminary technical content that demonstrates sufficient work has been completed to date.
